question: 2026年各客户晶圆收入排名
sql: SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) wafer_revenue FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id JOIN f360_sales_order so ON so.order_id=ol.order_id JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=so.customer_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.ship_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_code,c.customer_name ORDER BY wafer_revenue DESC
explanation: 收入采用已交付且客户验收晶圆数乘实际出货单价。

question: 产品P-ADAS-28A的Product 360核心指标
sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT ol.product_id,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) revenue,SUM(s.accepted_wafers) wafers FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' GROUP BY ol.product_id), yld AS (SELECT wl.product_id,SUM(yr.good_die)/NULLIF(SUM(yr.tested_die),0)*100 cp_yield FROM f360_yield_result yr JOIN f360_wafer_lot wl ON wl.lot_id=yr.lot_id WHERE yr.test_stage='CP' GROUP BY wl.product_id), qi AS (SELECT product_id,COUNT(*) incident_count FROM f360_quality_incident GROUP BY product_id) SELECT p.product_code,p.product_name,c.customer_name,a.application_name,n.node_name,NVL(r.revenue,0) wafer_revenue,NVL(r.wafers,0) accepted_wafers,y.cp_yield,NVL(q.incident_count,0) incident_count FROM f360_product p JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id JOIN f360_application a ON a.application_id=p.application_id JOIN f360_technology_node n ON n.node_id=p.node_id LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN yld y ON y.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN qi q ON q.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.product_code='P-ADAS-28A'
explanation: 收入、良率、客诉分别聚合到产品粒度后关联，避免多事实表放大。

question: 星驰智能汽车2026年Customer 360概览
sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT so.customer_id,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) revenue FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id JOIN f360_sales_order so ON so.order_id=ol.order_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.ship_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY so.customer_id), qi AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) incidents,SUM(CASE WHEN incident_status='OPEN' AND severity IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_major FROM f360_quality_incident GROUP BY customer_id), score AS (SELECT customer_id,overall_score,risk_level,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) rn FROM f360_customer_score_snapshot) SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,c.customer_tier,NVL(r.revenue,0) revenue,NVL(q.incidents,0) incidents,NVL(q.open_major,0) open_major,s.overall_score,s.risk_level FROM f360_customer c LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.customer_id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN qi q ON q.customer_id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN score s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.rn=1 WHERE c.customer_name='星驰智能汽车'
explanation: 客户收入、质量和最新健康度先独立聚合。

question: 2026年各Application收入和占比
sql: WITH app_rev AS (SELECT p.application_id,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) revenue FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=ol.product_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.ship_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY p.application_id) SELECT a.application_code,a.application_name,r.revenue,ROUND(100*r.revenue/NULLIF(SUM(r.revenue) OVER(),0),2) revenue_share_pct FROM app_rev r JOIN f360_application a ON a.application_id=r.application_id ORDER BY r.revenue DESC
explanation: 先按应用汇总收入，再使用窗口函数计算收入组合占比。

question: 2026年每月各晶圆厂和工艺节点产能利用率
sql: SELECT f.fab_code,n.node_code,cp.capacity_month,ROUND(100*SUM(cp.actual_start_wafers)/NULLIF(SUM(cp.available_wafers),0),2) utilization_pct FROM f360_capacity_plan cp JOIN f360_fab f ON f.fab_id=cp.fab_id JOIN f360_technology_node n ON n.node_id=cp.node_id WHERE cp.capacity_month>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND cp.capacity_month<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY f.fab_code,n.node_code,cp.capacity_month ORDER BY cp.capacity_month,f.fab_code,n.node_code
explanation: 利用率按厂、节点和月汇总实际投片与可用产能。

question: 各产品CP良率排名并显示测试量
sql: SELECT p.product_code,p.product_name,SUM(yr.tested_die) tested_die,SUM(yr.good_die) good_die,ROUND(100*SUM(yr.good_die)/NULLIF(SUM(yr.tested_die),0),2) cp_yield_pct FROM f360_yield_result yr JOIN f360_wafer_lot wl ON wl.lot_id=yr.lot_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=wl.product_id WHERE yr.test_stage='CP' GROUP BY p.product_code,p.product_name ORDER BY cp_yield_pct DESC
explanation: 使用good_die/tested_die加权计算，不平均lot百分比。

question: 哪些产品平均生产周期超过标准周期
sql: SELECT p.product_code,p.product_name,ROUND(AVG(wo.cycle_time_days),2) actual_cycle_days,ROUND(AVG(pr.standard_cycle_days),2) standard_cycle_days,ROUND(AVG(wo.cycle_time_days-pr.standard_cycle_days),2) gap_days FROM f360_wafer_output wo JOIN f360_wafer_lot wl ON wl.lot_id=wo.lot_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=wl.product_id JOIN f360_process_route pr ON pr.route_id=wl.route_id GROUP BY p.product_code,p.product_name HAVING AVG(wo.cycle_time_days)>AVG(pr.standard_cycle_days) ORDER BY gap_days DESC
explanation: 每个lot关联唯一制程路线后比较周期。

question: 2026年各客户OTIF
sql: WITH delivered AS (SELECT order_line_id,MAX(actual_delivery_date) actual_delivery_date,SUM(accepted_wafers) accepted_wafers FROM f360_shipment WHERE shipment_status='DELIVERED' GROUP BY order_line_id) SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,COUNT(*) due_lines,SUM(CASE WHEN d.actual_delivery_date<=ol.promised_date AND d.accepted_wafers>=ol.ordered_wafers THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) otif_lines,ROUND(100*AVG(CASE WHEN d.actual_delivery_date<=ol.promised_date AND d.accepted_wafers>=ol.ordered_wafers THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),2) otif_pct FROM f360_order_line ol JOIN f360_sales_order so ON so.order_id=ol.order_id JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=so.customer_id LEFT JOIN delivered d ON d.order_line_id=ol.order_line_id WHERE ol.promised_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND ol.promised_date<DATE '2027-01-01' AND ol.line_status<>'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.customer_code,c.customer_name ORDER BY otif_pct DESC
explanation: 先把多次出货聚合到订单行，再判断按时足量。

question: 2026年各产品预测准确率
sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT ol.product_id,TRUNC(s.ship_date,'MM') ship_month,SUM(s.shipped_wafers) shipped_wafers FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' GROUP BY ol.product_id,TRUNC(s.ship_date,'MM')) SELECT p.product_code,SUM(fc.forecast_wafers) forecast_wafers,SUM(NVL(a.shipped_wafers,0)) actual_wafers,ROUND(100*GREATEST(0,1-ABS(SUM(fc.forecast_wafers)-SUM(NVL(a.shipped_wafers,0)))/NULLIF(SUM(fc.forecast_wafers),0)),2) forecast_accuracy_pct FROM f360_customer_forecast fc JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=fc.product_id LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.product_id=fc.product_id AND a.ship_month=fc.forecast_month WHERE fc.forecast_version='PLAN_2026' GROUP BY p.product_code ORDER BY forecast_accuracy_pct DESC
explanation: 预测与实际按产品月份对齐，组合准确率先求和后计算。

question: 2026年各产品收入毛利和毛利率
sql: WITH ship AS (SELECT ol.product_id,TRUNC(s.ship_date,'MM') ship_month,SUM(s.accepted_wafers) wafers,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) revenue FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.ship_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ol.product_id,TRUNC(s.ship_date,'MM')), cost AS (SELECT product_id,cost_month,material_cost_usd+process_cost_usd+overhead_cost_usd+probe_cost_usd+scrap_cost_usd unit_cost FROM f360_product_cost) SELECT p.product_code,SUM(sh.revenue) revenue,SUM(sh.wafers*c.unit_cost) total_cost,SUM(sh.revenue-sh.wafers*c.unit_cost) gross_margin,ROUND(100*SUM(sh.revenue-sh.wafers*c.unit_cost)/NULLIF(SUM(sh.revenue),0),2) gross_margin_pct FROM ship sh JOIN cost c ON c.product_id=sh.product_id AND c.cost_month=sh.ship_month JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=sh.product_id GROUP BY p.product_code ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
explanation: 成本以产品月份关联，毛利率按汇总收入与成本计算。

question: 当前各客户未交付Backlog
sql: WITH delivered AS (SELECT order_line_id,SUM(accepted_wafers) accepted_wafers FROM f360_shipment WHERE shipment_status='DELIVERED' GROUP BY order_line_id) SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,SUM(GREATEST(ol.ordered_wafers-NVL(d.accepted_wafers,0),0)) backlog_wafers FROM f360_order_line ol JOIN f360_sales_order so ON so.order_id=ol.order_id JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=so.customer_id LEFT JOIN delivered d ON d.order_line_id=ol.order_line_id WHERE ol.line_status<>'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.customer_code,c.customer_name ORDER BY backlog_wafers DESC
explanation: 出货先按订单行汇总，取消行排除。

question: 最新库存快照中各产品库存和超龄库存
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) snapshot_date FROM f360_inventory_snapshot) SELECT p.product_code,SUM(i.wafer_quantity) inventory_wafers,SUM(CASE WHEN i.aging_days>90 THEN i.wafer_quantity ELSE 0 END) aged_inventory_wafers,SUM(i.reserved_wafers) reserved_wafers FROM f360_inventory_snapshot i JOIN latest l ON l.snapshot_date=i.snapshot_date JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_code ORDER BY aged_inventory_wafers DESC
explanation: 库存取全表最新快照，不能累计历史月份。

question: 各客户未关闭重大客诉数量
sql: SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,COUNT(DISTINCT qi.incident_id) open_major_incidents,SUM(qi.affected_wafers) affected_wafers FROM f360_quality_incident qi JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=qi.customer_id WHERE qi.incident_status='OPEN' AND qi.severity IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR') GROUP BY c.customer_code,c.customer_name ORDER BY open_major_incidents DESC,affected_wafers DESC
explanation: 重大客诉限定OPEN且严重度为CRITICAL或MAJOR。

question: 未来12个月各Application的Design Win加权管线
sql: SELECT a.application_code,a.application_name,SUM(dw.estimated_annual_wafers*dw.probability_pct/100) weighted_pipeline_wafers FROM f360_design_win dw JOIN f360_application a ON a.application_id=dw.application_id WHERE dw.opportunity_stage NOT IN ('WON','LOST') AND dw.target_sop_date>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND dw.target_sop_date<DATE '2027-07-01' GROUP BY a.application_code,a.application_name ORDER BY weighted_pipeline_wafers DESC
explanation: 仅开放机会进入管线并按概率加权。

question: 列出高风险或延期的NPI里程碑
sql: SELECT p.product_code,p.product_name,nm.milestone_type,nm.planned_date,nm.actual_date,nm.milestone_status,nm.risk_level FROM f360_npi_milestone nm JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=nm.product_id WHERE nm.risk_level='HIGH' OR nm.milestone_status='DELAYED' ORDER BY nm.planned_date,p.product_code
explanation: 同时覆盖尚未完成的高风险节点和已完成但延期的节点。

question: 各晶圆厂非计划停机时长和损失产能
sql: SELECT f.fab_code,f.fab_name,SUM(ed.downtime_hours) downtime_hours,SUM(ed.lost_wafers) lost_wafers FROM f360_equipment_downtime ed JOIN f360_fab f ON f.fab_id=ed.fab_id WHERE ed.downtime_type='UNPLANNED' GROUP BY f.fab_code,f.fab_name ORDER BY lost_wafers DESC
explanation: 只统计UNPLANNED设备停机。

question: 最新客户健康度排名
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT s.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC) rn FROM f360_customer_score_snapshot s) SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,r.overall_score,r.risk_level,r.revenue_score,r.growth_score,r.quality_score,r.engagement_score FROM ranked r JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=r.customer_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY r.overall_score DESC
explanation: 每个客户只使用最新评分快照。

question: 最新季度各Application市场份额
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT application_id,MAX(market_quarter) market_quarter FROM f360_application_market GROUP BY application_id) SELECT a.application_code,a.application_name,m.market_quarter,m.served_sam_usd,m.fab_revenue_usd,ROUND(100*m.fab_revenue_usd/NULLIF(m.served_sam_usd,0),2) market_share_pct FROM f360_application_market m JOIN latest l ON l.application_id=m.application_id AND l.market_quarter=m.market_quarter JOIN f360_application a ON a.application_id=m.application_id ORDER BY market_share_pct DESC
explanation: 份额分母为SAM，并取各应用最新季度。

question: 2026年实际出货单价低于协议价的产品
sql: SELECT p.product_code,c.customer_name,ROUND(SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd)/NULLIF(SUM(s.accepted_wafers),0),2) actual_asp,ROUND(SUM(s.accepted_wafers*pa.agreed_unit_price_usd)/NULLIF(SUM(s.accepted_wafers),0),2) agreed_asp,ROUND(SUM(s.accepted_wafers*(s.unit_price_usd-pa.agreed_unit_price_usd)),2) price_variance_usd FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=ol.product_id JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id JOIN f360_price_agreement pa ON pa.customer_id=p.customer_id AND pa.product_id=p.product_id AND s.ship_date BETWEEN pa.effective_from AND pa.effective_to WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.ship_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_code,c.customer_name HAVING SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd)<SUM(s.accepted_wafers*pa.agreed_unit_price_usd) ORDER BY price_variance_usd
explanation: 协议必须覆盖实际出货日期，价差按晶圆量加权。

question: 2026年各工艺节点收入和产品数
sql: SELECT n.node_code,n.node_name,COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) product_count,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) revenue FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=ol.product_id JOIN f360_technology_node n ON n.node_id=p.node_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.ship_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY n.node_code,n.node_name ORDER BY revenue DESC
explanation: 收入经产品归因到工艺节点。

question: 每个客户最近90天负向互动占比
sql: SELECT c.customer_code,c.customer_name,COUNT(*) interaction_count,SUM(CASE WHEN ci.sentiment_score<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negative_count,ROUND(100*AVG(CASE WHEN ci.sentiment_score<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),2) negative_rate_pct FROM f360_customer_interaction ci JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=ci.customer_id WHERE ci.interaction_date>=DATE '2026-04-01' AND ci.interaction_date<DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_code,c.customer_name ORDER BY negative_rate_pct DESC
explanation: 测试期间固定为2026年第二季度，负向定义为sentiment_score小于0。

question: 收入最高的前5个产品及客户和Application
sql: SELECT p.product_code,p.product_name,c.customer_name,a.application_name,SUM(s.accepted_wafers*s.unit_price_usd) revenue FROM f360_shipment s JOIN f360_order_line ol ON ol.order_line_id=s.order_line_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=ol.product_id JOIN f360_customer c ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id JOIN f360_application a ON a.application_id=p.application_id WHERE s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' GROUP BY p.product_code,p.product_name,c.customer_name,a.application_name ORDER BY revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
explanation: Oracle 19c使用FETCH FIRST，不使用LIMIT。

question: 哪些产品CP良率低于90%且存在未关闭客诉
sql: WITH y AS (SELECT wl.product_id,100*SUM(yr.good_die)/NULLIF(SUM(yr.tested_die),0) cp_yield FROM f360_yield_result yr JOIN f360_wafer_lot wl ON wl.lot_id=yr.lot_id WHERE yr.test_stage='CP' GROUP BY wl.product_id), q AS (SELECT product_id,COUNT(*) open_incidents FROM f360_quality_incident WHERE incident_status='OPEN' GROUP BY product_id) SELECT p.product_code,p.product_name,ROUND(y.cp_yield,2) cp_yield_pct,q.open_incidents FROM y JOIN q ON q.product_id=y.product_id JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=y.product_id WHERE y.cp_yield<90 ORDER BY y.cp_yield
explanation: 良率和客诉独立聚合后关联，避免测试记录与事件交叉放大。

question: 预测大于可用产能的月份和工艺节点
sql: WITH demand AS (SELECT p.node_id,fc.forecast_month,SUM(fc.forecast_wafers) demand_wafers FROM f360_customer_forecast fc JOIN f360_product p ON p.product_id=fc.product_id WHERE fc.forecast_version='PLAN_2026' GROUP BY p.node_id,fc.forecast_month), cap AS (SELECT node_id,capacity_month,SUM(available_wafers) capacity_wafers FROM f360_capacity_plan GROUP BY node_id,capacity_month) SELECT n.node_code,d.forecast_month,d.demand_wafers,c.capacity_wafers,d.demand_wafers-c.capacity_wafers capacity_gap FROM demand d JOIN cap c ON c.node_id=d.node_id AND c.capacity_month=d.forecast_month JOIN f360_technology_node n ON n.node_id=d.node_id WHERE d.demand_wafers>c.capacity_wafers ORDER BY capacity_gap DESC
explanation: 预测先按节点月份汇总，产能也按相同粒度汇总后比较。
